summary: WISeQey Corp., formerly WISeKey International, disclosed that its redomiciliation from Switzerland to the British Virgin Islands became legally effective on October 1, 2026, via a cross-border merger of WISeKey into its wholly owned BVI subsidiary, WISeQey, as survivor. Legacy WISeKey ADSs trade on Nasdaq and Class B shares on SIX through October 2, 2026; WISeQey ordinary shares begin trading under WQEY on both venues October 5, 2026. Exchange ratios: one WISeKey ADS for one-half WISeQey ordinary share; each Class B share for one ordinary share, or ten unlisted Class B shares if elected. No price, premium, or advisor named.
